0.0.n: Points to the story the narrator is introducing.

0.1.n: Marks これ as the topic; the explanation follows in the next line.

1.0.n: A personal pronoun commonly used by boys and men, with a softer feel than 俺.

1.1.n: Identifies 僕 as the person who becomes a hero.

1.2.n: Describes the highest rank or quality and connects to ヒーロー with の.

1.3.n: Connects 最高 to ヒーロー so it describes the kind of hero.

1.4.n: A word borrowed from English, written in katakana.

1.5.n: Marks the role reached through なる: becoming a hero.

1.6.n: The plain nonpast form of なる; unlike the English subtitle, it is not past tense.

1.7.n: Sets becoming a hero as the endpoint of the story's journey.

1.8.n: Connects the entire phrase ending in まで to 物語, describing what period the story covers.

1.9.n: Names the narrative being introduced; this line leaves the final だ unstated.

2.0.n: Connects the first description of the story to the broader description that follows.

3.0.n: Broadens the focus from the narrator alone to the whole group.

3.1.n: Identifies みんな as the people who become heroes.

3.2.n: Describes the highest rank or quality and connects to ヒーロー with の.

3.3.n: Connects 最高 to ヒーロー so it describes the kind of heroes.

3.4.n: Japanese nouns usually do not mark singular or plural; みんな makes a plural reading natural here.

3.5.n: Marks the role reached through なる: becoming heroes.

3.6.n: The plain nonpast form of なる presents becoming heroes as the endpoint, not as a past-tense verb.

3.7.n: Sets everyone's becoming heroes as the endpoint of the journey.

3.8.n: Attaches the whole phrase ending in まで to 物語, describing the span of the story.

3.9.n: The main noun describing what これ refers to, now followed by だ.

3.10.n: Plain statement ending used after a noun; です would be the polite equivalent.

0.tip: は introduces a topic whose explanation continues in the next line.

1.lit: The story up until I become the greatest hero.
1.tip: なるまでの物語 means a story covering the journey up until someone becomes something.

2.tip: そして links this introduction to a second, broader description.

3.lit: And it is the story up until everyone becomes the greatest heroes.
3.tip: Replacing 僕 with みんな expands the story from one person's journey to everyone's.
